bio.text: Henderson Haws represents Idaho House District 16, Seat B, and is an attorney based in Boise, according to the Idaho Legislature's member page, which lists a first term.

The legislature biography says Henderson Haws was born in Nampa, Idaho, and holds a Bachelor of Arts in religious studies from Lewis and Clark College and a Juris Doctor from the University of Idaho College of Law.
The biography also lists work as an adjunct professor at the University of Idaho College of Law and as a judicial law clerk for the U.S. District Court for the District of Idaho.
